Sk-67 2 (HIP 22237), is a candidate hypervelocity star, the TGAS proper motion implying a very large peculiar transverse velocity (∼360 km/s) directed radially away from the LMC centre.
Therefore Sk-67 2 is clearly unbound with respect to the LMC and, as we argue below, a possible hypervelocity star.
We conclude that Sk-67 2 is a candidate hypervelocity star that if confirmed, by for example Gaia Data Release 2 (DR2), would warrant further investigation as to the nature of its origin.
